judge.voice: The debate itself was decent. Dana asked proper B2 questions, and I could get help without leaving the scene. But the help started too simple. "Said more simply" is not what I need at B2, and the useful phrase only came on the third press. Then the "Try:" line basically wrote my first answer for me. I asked "Was that correct?" and got a yes, which is fine. But there was no coaching note, no replay, and nothing quoting what I actually said. That is exactly the "tell me exactly what was wrong" part I came for. The recap also says "2 with help" when I answered the third question alone. A tutor would have pushed me to try it again. I'd use it for the questions, but not yet as a replacement for my exam tutor.
